name: io.github.oreondev/harbor-mcp
title: Harbor
description: Read-only access to a Harbor registry: projects, artifacts, vulnerabilities, robots and replication.

environmentVariables.name: HARBOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Harbor base URL, for example https://harbor.example.com

environmentVariables.name: HARBOR_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Harbor user or robot account; a read-only system robot is recommended

environmentVariables.name: HARBOR_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to skip TLS verification of Harbor
